description: A small utensil with a shallow rounded end that I use to eat soup or cereal.
Something I reach for when I need to stir coffee or scoop a little sugar.
A piece of cutlery that holds liquid or small portions of food.
It has a handle and a little bowl-shaped end, unlike a fork.
The utensil I use to taste a sauce while it is cooking.
A utensil with several pointed prongs that helps me pick up pieces of food.

A dining tool for piercing and lifting food.
A flat round dish that I put my meal on before eating.

A dish with a broad flat center and a slightly raised edge.
A sturdy cup with a handle that I usually use for coffee or tea.
Something ceramic that I can wrap my fingers around while drinking a hot beverage.

The item on my desk that holds my morning coffee.
A handled drinking vessel for a warm drink.

The kitchen item that makes water hot enough for instant noodles.
